notes.title: The game will soon become free to play
notes.content: Since the game essentially has no downloads, but I still want to share this interesting game with everyone, it will be changed to free in a week.

notes.title: Fixed and Added
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Added three smaller sizes, 800x600, 640x480, and 320x240, for more convenient slacking off.
[*]Fixed the bug where x2 does not disappear in the bottom left corner.
[/olist]

notes.title: Regular updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Renamed the Easy mode on the main menu to "Practice", and achievements and leaderboards cannot be unlocked in this mode.
[*]Fixed the leaderboard to make it more compact and seamless.
[/list]

notes.title: A lot of Updates
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. After a long time, a lot of content has been updated this time~


This update is as follows:

[olist]

[*] A new mode has been added: simple mode (there is no random square, and you can always get rid of gems at the beginning of the game, but this play method is not included in your achievements)

[*] Added statistics and achievement system

[*] Added leaderboard function

[*] The database has been encrypted (sorry, because of this change, the user data of the previous version will be lost)

[*] Supports macOS 64 bit

[*] Added English and Chinese language support

[/olist]


In addition, you are welcome to put forward any suggestions and ideas, and try to update them into the game for everyone to experience.
